notes:
ADDED
- Classic special skins now look like the original game, in the arena and in the Skin preview: one eye, closed eyes, slug, double beads, and the antenna and bulb skins. The one-eye skin has a bigger head shadow.
- Your own photo as the arena floor. Touch and hold it to delete it.
- Minimap icons: teammates show their team icon, and friends in the same arena show their Wyrm icon. Change this in Settings â€º Display â€º Minimap icons.
- Global chat: bold, italic and other formatting, previews for every link, @mentions for any player, and a list of who is active right now.
- Arena picker: community arenas are in the list now, with search. Tap an arena to play. "Add IP" opens a popup. Touch and hold saved arenas to delete several at once.
- A field where you can paste a skin code.
- Your arena player ID with a Copy button, under Developer.
- Near Original shows length, kills and rank at the bottom.
- Player names in Hindi, Chinese, Arabic and fancy fonts now show in the arena.

CHANGED
- Smoother frames: a steadier game step in long matches, and the display holds its full frame rate.
- Snakes no longer lose beads or shadows when the arena is crowded.
- Auto zoom works like the original game.
- Tag ropes show on every row of the wardrobe.
- Your bot stays away from the killer ring at the arena's edge.

REMOVED
- The "arena dropped you" card.

FIXED
- The keyboard no longer jumps twice in the Ready Room and the arena chat, and it closes when you change page.
- Chat text with emoji or curly quotes now shows correctly in the arena.
- The in-game ping now shows correctly.
- Team identity fix: teammates find you correctly.
- The Shed screen stayed blurred.
